goal: The lead-on twin of drive-rhino-headlong-on: the same search, the same seeds and genomes, with the pilot-side AI nose lead switched on in the model (nose_rate 1.5, nose_lead 2.5; Tools/Build/ai_nose_lead.py, the model of AIPilot.NoseLeadGain from PR #1786, which the game ships at 0). the Rhino drive model's published numbers assumed a lag-free nose, so the fleet lag (1.5/s) is switched on with the lead; the Rhino never missed a mouth, so this twin mostly checks that assumption. Garrett's plan (REGATTA_BALANCE_PLAN.md, the direction since 2026-11-06) judges every hull and every course on AIs that do not overshoot ring mouths, so each hull's drive is searched again with the lead on and compared with its lead-off twin on the same courses: the lead-on winner is the drive proposed for the day Yash turns the switch on. Run by hand until Compute is back (Shombith paused it 2026-11-06): /mnt/project-files/regatta-training/local_run.py, two independent restarts (labels B, C). Parent goal: Fix the Rhino's I4 stalls (2026-11-06): the drive searched on the model with Headlong's own gate distances, AIPilot's orbit break-off and AICommitFromApproachPoint ON, the steering every other gate race flies. Run by hand (regatta-training/local_run.py) until Froglet Compute is switched back on.
promote: Only after Yash turns AIPilot.NoseLeadGain on (PR #1786) and its editor check passes; then as the parent's rule, against the parent's winner raced WITH the lead: A PROPOSAL for the AI owner (Yash): if they agree, write the best fields into Assets/Resources/AIBoostPolicies/<the Rhino's policy>_Headlong.asset with the learner's writer (learn_drives_from_flights.py), never by hand; the AI learning sweep keeps imitating people on top of it.
